overview: Israel is a country in Western Asia, on the eastern shore of the Mediterranean Sea. It declared independence in 1948. Israel considers Jerusalem its capital, but the city's status is disputed and most countries keep their embassies in Tel Aviv. Hebrew is the official language, and Arabic has a special status. The land is sacred to Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and the conflict between Israelis and Palestinians remains unresolved.

geography.text: Israel is small but varied. A fertile coastal plain runs along the Mediterranean, hills rise inland, and the Jordan Rift Valley runs down the east, containing the Sea of Galilee and the Dead Sea, the lowest place on land on Earth. The south is the Negev desert, which reaches the Red Sea at Eilat.
